Author: Anjuli Palo

In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Crr No. 2803 of 2022 (Ramani
Ice Cream Pvt. Ltd. Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Dated : 01-08-2022 Shri Naman
Nagrath, Senior Advocate with Shri Jubin Prasad, Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Garima Tiwari, Panel Lawyer for the State.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on the question of admission.
Record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
Also heard on I.A. No.14010/2022, which is first application filed on behalf of the applicant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted by the trial Court under Section 7 read with Section 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 6 months with fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation.
The aforesaid conviction and sentence has been affirmed by the appellate Court.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the maximum sentence awarded to the appellant is 06 months.
The jail sentence of the applicant is suspended till 03.08.2022 by the trial Court itself.
He further submits that applicant is aged about 72 years and fine amount has already been deposited on 31.08.2017 by him as mentioned in the application.
Disposal of this revision will take considerable time, therefore, the jail sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the application.

SAN Although record is not available, however, looking to the nature of Date: 2022.08.02 11:29:07 IST allegation against the applicant and period of jail sentence awarded to the applicant, I find it to be a fit case to suspend the custodial sentence of the applicant and to release him on bail, therefore,
without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of applicant-Mulchand Mahar remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 04.01.2023 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard.

The applicant shall regularly appear before the trial Court during the pendency of this revision without fail.
List the matter after four weeks.
(SMT. ANJULI PALO) JUDGE Nitesh Ramani Ice Cream Pvt. Ltd. vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 1 August, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30975841/
